title: Watch the preview · Teleion Labs
description: A 52-second recorded preview of Teleion Fabric and Eranos, with captions and a transcript.

blocks.title: See agents share the work.
blocks.lead: A quick look at Teleion Fabric and Eranos, our public-good application for nonprofits.

blocks.label: Teleion Fabric and Eranos recorded product preview
blocks.context: Recorded preview. Screens show a work-in-progress interface. Benchmark scenes show local queue tests and offline model evaluations, not live service guarantees. The 256-worker result used local test workers; the task-splitting F1 result is the original Glimmer adapter on 106 held-out fixtures. Hourly worker-policy updates are separate from adapter training. The collision count reflects the local test detector; it is not proof of exactly-once work.
transcript: AI is smart. The way we use it is frustratingly dumb: agents miss what is new, rewrite existing code, and stall on long queues.
Teleion Labs builds Teleion Fabric so agents share work, check results with a separate key, and reuse vetted kits, free with no account through December 31, 2026.

Measured on recorded runs: zero lease collisions across 256 workers, hourly self-tuning over Meta’s Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0, and 97.8 percent held-out Task-splitting F1 on our compact Muse Glimmer 30B adapter.
Eranos shows Teleion Fabric working for nonprofits on cited public-source requests. Start free at teleionlabs.com, or lend spare AI capacity at eranosforgood.org.
